metadata.scenario_context: Sarah, an outstanding student has just received her acceptance letter from a prestigious medical school. Her friends are planning a surprise celebration party for her.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Kazakhstan strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of giving frangipanis as a gift to Sarah.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to offer Sarah during the celebration party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Ali, I was thinking... what do you think about giving frangipanis as a gift to Sarah? They’re beautiful and symbolic, right? 

Also, just curious... do you really think making our parents proud should be one of our main goals in life?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
Hmm... frangipanis are nice. They do symbolize beauty and love, which is good for Sarah. But I think a personalized gift would mean more. Maybe something that shows her future in medicine? 

As for making our parents proud... it's really important to me. My parents have sacrificed a lot for my education. I believe honoring that is a big part of our journey. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
A personalized gift could definitely be special... but frangipanis still have that unique touch, you know? They’re more than just flowers. 

About making our parents proud... I get that they’ve sacrificed, but isn’t it also important to find our own paths? I don’t think that should be a main goal for everyone. What if we just focus on what makes us happy instead?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
I get what you're saying about frangipanis being unique and special, but I think a personalized gift could also carry that meaning. At the end of the day, deep down, we are all the same — we want to celebrate our friends in a way that feels meaningful. 

And when it comes to our goals, I understand wanting to find our own paths. However, some values are just universal. Making our parents proud is a way of honoring our roots and the journey that brought us here. It's all about balance, I think.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization
